about_the_game:
Sign Up for Pre-Alpha Playtesting

The game is still in the early stages of development, but we are opening the doors for playtest sign-ups right now to get direct feedback from you, the player, as we build and grow this game over time. Join our community of pre-alpha players to be part of our journey.

No Steam Early Access, no Founder or Access Passes. Just Sign Up on our homepage and we’ll invite you to play when the time comes. If the current test is full, don’t worry, we’ll call you up for the next available one.

What We're Building

Step into the realm of Hamarvast, a world of power struggles, magical chaos, and the ultimate quest for godhood. Join other players, each aligned with a kingdom, and clash in huge epic battles that shape the fate of the continent.

Forge alliances, spark full-scale wars, or master the art of subtle sabotage to claim victory on your own terms.

Large Scale Multiplayer

Each war brings together a large group of players, split into kingdoms, working together to grow stronger while facing constant shifts in politics, power struggles, strategy, and magical battles driven by the players themselves.

Be Resourceful

Exploring and making use of nearby areas helps your kingdom grow through resource gathering, building defenses, and learning about your neighbors. How you use that knowledge can mean the difference between rising to power or being forgotten.

Learning to Spell

The Arcanum is where your magical power grows. By collecting runes, earned through battles with powerful elemental creatures, you can unlock new spells, upgrade existing ones and become a force to be reckoned with.

You Are the Hero

Take direct control of unique hero classes, each with their own strengths and abilities. Whether you're a hammer-wielding battlemage, a clever necromancer, or a spellcasting priestess, your hero’s power can turn the tide of war.

Free-To-Play

We Will Be Gods will be free-to-play, meaning anyone can jump in and experience the full game without needing to pay anything upfront. Players will be able to explore the world, take part in epic battles, rise through the ranks, and shape their kingdom’s future, all without spending a cent.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700HQ or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: We Will Be Gods is a free-to-play strategy war game on a massive scale. Large kingdoms of players must work together to face-off against other player-owned kingdoms, battling it out in massive, months-long wars in a bid to attain godhood and ultimate victory.
